<?php
namespace App\Services;

class FieldEncryptionService
{
    private function getKey(): string
    {
        $hex = env('FIELD_ENC_KEY_HEX');
        if (empty($hex)) throw new \RuntimeException('FIELD_ENC_KEY_HEX not set');
        $key = hex2bin($hex);
        if (strlen($key) !== 32) throw new \RuntimeException('Field key must be 256 bits');
        return $key;
    }

    public function encrypt(string $value): string
    {
        $key = $this->getKey();
        $iv  = random_bytes(12);
        $ct  = openssl_encrypt($value, 'AES-256-GCM', $key, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag);
        return base64_encode($iv . $tag . $ct);
    }

    public function decrypt(string $enc): string
    {
        $key  = $this->getKey();
        $raw  = base64_decode($enc);
        [$iv, $tag, $ct] = [substr($raw, 0, 12), substr($raw, 12, 16), substr($raw, 28)];
        return openssl_decrypt($ct, 'AES-256-GCM', $key, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag) ?: '';
    }
}
